page_note: 这一页是报告6.3节正文加一张编号为Figure 1的百分比堆叠柱状图，展示11个国家/地区受访者气候变化担忧变化的三类占比。

heading.title: When asked, most consumers say their concerns about climate change have increased in the past two years
heading.subtitle: Q : How have your climate change concerns changed over the past two years?

figures.source_line: Source : Bain & Company, The Visionary CEO's Guide to Sustainability, 2024. 26

components.evidence: each country bar holds three colour segments, e.g. Overall 61%, 31%, 8% stacked
all eleven bars reach the same top and the axis top tick reads `100%`
`61%`, `31%`, `8%` printed on the segments of the Overall bar
three swatch entries in a row under the category axis, below `Overall ... Indonesia`
`Source : Bain & Company, The Visionary CEO's Guide to Sustainability, 2024. 26` under the plot
superscript `26` after `personal experiences` and trailing the source line; `27` in later paragraph

new_components.name: survey_question_subtitle
new_components.evidence: second heading line reads `Q : How have your climate change concerns changed over the past two years?` in bold
new_components.why_it_matters: 该行是问卷题干而非图表标题，读数时需要靠它才能知道三个图例项属于同一道单选题、堆叠合计为100%。

new_components.name: stack_total_not_exactly_100
new_components.why_it_matters: 标签之和并不总等于100%，说明数值来自四舍五入而非从像素高度推算，取值必须用打印标签。

spot_checks.mark: the Italy bar, middle (not changed) segment

difficulty_notes: 取值本身不难：33个分段全部印了标签，无需按刻度估读（刻度只有`0`和`100%`两档，若靠像素读数5%容差几乎不可能，但这里不必）。真正的瓶颈是定位标签：同一数字在图中反复出现——`8%`出现在Overall、UK、France、Indonesia的顶段，`51%`出现在US与Germany，`62%`出现在Japan与China，`4%`出现在Japan与Brazil。因此一行必须同时携带国家名（`Germany`）和完整图例文本（`My concerns have subsied/decreased`），而这三段图例文字位于绘图区下方、与柱体无对应关系，解析器很容易只输出11列国家而丢掉系列名，或把三行折叠成一行。

suggestions.what_to_add: unit_in_axis_or_title 与 axis_title_above_axis 的组合（`Percentage of respondent` 置于 `100%` 顶刻度之上）
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段中新增 unit_position 维度：axis_side / above_top_tick / in_title
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位置于顶刻度上方 vs 置于轴标题处，比较导出表能否恢复百分比量纲

suggestions.what_to_add: survey_question_subtitle（题干作为第二行标题）与 figure_number `Figure 1:` 的拆分
suggestions.where_to_change: 记录字段中把标题拆成 number/title/subtitle/unit，并规定 subtitle 以粗体行落在表格上方
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有无题干副标题时，模型能否把三条图例判定为同一单选题的互斥选项

suggestions.what_to_add: 长图例文本作为系列键（`My concerns have intensifed/increased` 等三条置于绘图区下方）
suggestions.where_to_change: 整页 markdown 导出规则：图例行必须成为表格列头而非游离文本
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 系列名长度（>30字符）与图例位置（下方 vs 内嵌）对定位重复数值成功率的影响

suggestions.where_to_change: 条件行中加入 aggregate_category 标记，仅以字体加粗而非配色区分
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 汇总类别仅用粗体标注时，能否与其余10个国家类别区分开
